llm_response.reason: The site displays multiple scam characteristics: offers of 'Cheap Courier Massive Discount' for parcel delivery at unrealistic rates (unusually low prices), strong urgency tactics ('Searching.....', 'Shipment confirmed!'), lack of company identification or contact information, prompts for delivery info (phishing attempt), and having no legitimate links or standard business transparency. WHOIS records show non-transparent registration (no registrant data), making the site anonymous and highly suspicious. All evident traits indicate a typical fake online shopping or phishing scam targeting users awaiting or expecting packages.
